integrity: All mathematical statements derive from the explicit distance formulas, pairwise separation proof and constructive slide paths; two finite standalone programs corroborate, without independently proving the infinite claim. Independent scholarly validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The results apply to the Cartesian product of a complete graph and a two-vertex path. A first-public-date qualification applies to the cited foundational source, not the date of this theorem. Closed bases counts and slide connectivity are proved only for n at least seven; exact mobility diameters are not claimed. The unindexed historical literature may contain overlapping findings.
title: A seven-column transition and connected edge-metric basis mobility in complete prisms
